item.title: Bulletin updated at 06:20 HKT 26/Mar/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Winds will be weak over Guangdong today. A fresh easterly airstream will affect the coastal areas between tonight and tomorrow. Temperatures will drop slightly over the region. A southerly airstream is expected to bring hot weather to the coast of Guangdong again in the latter part of this week to early next week. Meanwhile, under the influence of upper-air disturbances, the weather will be unsettled over southern China over the weekend and early next week. There will be showers and thunderstorms.
